name: Unicorn
overview: The biblical references to the unicorn symbolize great strength and intractability, often illustrating God's power and the might of His people. Numbers 23:22 and 24:8 portray the unicorn's strength as a metaphor for God's deliverance and victorious power over enemies. Deuteronomy 33:17 uses the image of unicorn horns to represent the exaltation and strength of the descendants of Joseph, emphasizing their ability to overcome nations. Job 39:9-11 highlights the unicorn's untamable nature and formidable strength, underscoring its figurative role in demonstrating both the wildness of creation and the sovereign strength of God.
